title: MCP baseline state
description: Versioned trusted and candidate normalized metadata baselines. Header values and input credentials are not stored in these records. Cross-run mutation ownership is provided by dedicated Apify Request Queues, not advisory KVS records.

executiveSummary.title: Executive trust-gate summary
executiveSummary.description: Machine-readable ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK decision and run totals.

markdownReport.title: Markdown security report
markdownReport.description: Human-readable decisions and prioritized security findings.

csvReport.title: CSV evidence report
csvReport.description: Formula-safe server decisions and classified findings for spreadsheets and audit queues.

trustedBaselines.title: Trusted baselines
trustedBaselines.description: Trusted redacted snapshots used for future drift comparisons.

candidateBaselines.title: Candidate baselines
candidateBaselines.description: Redacted snapshots held separately for human review. Each candidate records the exact trusted parent snapshot hash, or null when no trusted parent existed, and is deleted after successful exact-lineage promotion.
